title: Report On T. Saiki, Japanese Deported From Calcutta

page_data.en:
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Crime & Special Branches Station
Headquarters SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
Date C.D. REGISTRO
No. I. Q. D. 11182.
Date 7 - 5 - 30
Subject (in full) T. Saiki, Japanese, deported from Calcutta.
Made by C.D.I. Nakagawa. Forwarded by P.A (C.S.B)
Sir,
Acting under your instructions I accompanied by C.D.S.
119 proceeded to the S.S. Tilawa as soon as she arrived and
berthed at S & H Pootung Wharf at 5.40 p.m. May 5, 1930 and
inquired from the Purser into the case referred to above. He
states that he was asked by the Calcutta authorities to hand
over to the Kobe Police authorities T. Saiki who was deported
from Calcutta. Accordingly Saiki was not permitted to land at
ports of call on the way.
T. Saiki was interrogated and made the following state-
ment:- "I am Tatsugoro Saiki, 45, single seaman (oiler). When
I arrived at Calcutta in January 1927 aboard the S.S. Hakuho
Maru, I deserted from the ship and worked as an assistant in a
motor cycle repairing shop at No. 25 Kitapor, Calcutta, owned
by one of my friends named S. Machida. In March 1929 the
Calcutta authorities discovered that I was a deserter and that
I was not in possession of a passport and as a result I was
charged and found guilty and fined $700. As I could not pay
the fine, I was sent to prison for one year and on the expiry
of the term of the sentence ordered to be deported to Japan."
D.C.P. S. Nakagawa
Crime & Special Branches. C.D.I.

日期 30年5月7日
事由（全称） 日本人 T. Saiki，自加尔各答被驱逐出境。
呈报人：刑事侦缉探员 Nakagawa。转呈人：警佐（刑事与特别部门）
阁下，
遵照阁下的指示，我偕同刑事侦缉警员 119 号，于1930年5月5日下午5时40分“蒂拉瓦”号（S.S. Tilawa）轮抵达并停靠在三北洋行浦东码头后，立即登轮，并向事务长查询上述案件。事务长称，加尔各答当局要求其将自加尔各答被驱逐出境的 T. Saiki 移交给神户警察当局。因此，Saiki 未被允许在沿途停靠港口上岸。
经讯问，T. Saiki 作出如下陈述：“我是 Tatsugoro Saiki，45岁，单身，海员（加油工）。1927年1月，我乘坐‘白凤丸’号（S.S. Hakuho Maru）抵达加尔各答时，从船上潜逃，并在加尔各答 Kitapor 路25号的一家摩托车修理店担任助手，该店由我的一位名叫 S. Machida 的朋友所有。1929年3月，加尔各答当局发现我是逃兵，且未持有护照，因此我被起诉并被判有罪，罚款700元。因我无法缴纳罚款，被判处监禁一年，刑满后被命令驱逐回日本。”
副督察 S. Nakagawa
刑事与特别部门。刑事侦缉探员。

C.I.D. Headquarters.
REPORT
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. April D. 44. 830
Date 17 . 4 . 30
Subject (in full) T. Saiki, Japanese, deported from Calcutta.
Made by J.C.D.I. Nakagawa. Forwarded by
Sir,
With reference to the attached, I beg to report that
Mr. Hamasato, Chief of Police, and Mr. Akagi, Chief of the
Intelligence Office of the Japanese Consulate-General, were
informed. Mr. Akagi states that should he receive information
regarding Saiki it would be furnished to us immediately.
The S.S. Tilawa is expected to arrive here on May 5, 1930
and dock at the P. & O. Pootung Wharf.
S. Nakagawa
J.C.D.I.
Forwarded for information

呈报人：初级刑事侦缉探员 Nakagawa。转呈人：
阁下，
关于附件事宜，谨报告已通知日本总领事馆警察署长 Hamasato 先生及情报科科长 Akagi 先生。Akagi 先生表示，一旦收到关于 Saiki 的消息，将立即提供给我方。
“蒂拉瓦”号（S.S. Tilawa）轮预计于1930年5月5日抵达此处，并停靠于半岛东方轮船公司（P. & O.）浦东码头。
